line: List the people you're thankful for, then tell one of them.
paragraph: A university student in Providence spent her summer with teenagers learning English. They played vocabulary games and wrote in journals. She also took them into the neighborhood to practice. One student spoke with a cashier at a local market. Another learned new words to describe what she saw. The teenagers found their voices in a language that was still becoming theirs.

seed.summary: For a group of teenagers learning English in Providence, Rhode Island, summer school this year looked a little different. seed.sourceTitle: Brown Student Spends Summer Helping Teens Find Their Voice in English
